newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia may abandon media rules probe-paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia may abandon media rules probe-paper.

text.p: The Australian government may abandon its planned full public inquiry into media ownership rules and instead issue a limited government policy paper, The Australian newspaper said on Monday.
"The (governing Liberal-National) Coalition is considering abandoning its promised inquiry into the Australian media in favour of a government green paper on media policy," The Australian said.
